asked.item: All LinkedIn slot expected to post to profile and company page
Why the post went only to the company page
How to get it on the personal profile too

verdict.reason: The help pages explain that All LinkedIn only makes a slot available and the destination selected on the post controls where it publishes.

steps.text: The destination selected on the post controls where it publishes.
All LinkedIn means posts targeting any connected LinkedIn personal profile or company Page are allowed to use the slot, but it does not publish one post to every LinkedIn destination.
To publish the same content to a personal profile and a company Page, create one post for each destination.
To move a post to your personal profile in the web app, open the post draft, select your LinkedIn personal profile as the destination, and schedule the post again.
